'''Gi Dopa Gasha''' was the collective name for [[Tatoo I/Legends|Tatoo I]] and [[Tatoo II/Legends|Tatoo II]], the twin [[Star/Legends|suns]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], in [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]].
